desc: 加高围挡背架加深抽屉的浅木书桌，靠窗冷日光书房位收纳主线
leaf: 带加高围挡背架与多层抽屉的浅木色固定式电脑书桌（写字台，非升降学习桌、非桌椅套装）
name: 浅木加高围挡抽屉书桌款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒交代加高围挡背架加深抽屉这条收纳主线，用靠窗真实书房角与椅子、台灯锚定尺度，让人把自己家套进去。
shots.textZone: upper-left block: one marigold #EFAE33 rounded tab holding 「{callout_1}」, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 over 「{selling_point_2}」, one two-line sub 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」, a small plus mark; top-right carries only a neutral English label with a hairline underline and no name

shots.intent: 正俯拍摊乱的桌面与床边堆放两栏同框，把没有围挡没有抽屉的杂乱痛点摆到眼前，逼出收纳主线。
shots.textZone: top band headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus one small plus mark; each panel carries one marigold #EFAE33 label bar at its bottom edge with a rounded-square chip glyph and one label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 另一侧机位交代围挡背架与桌面在窗边的实际占位与氛围，把首屏的口号落到能用的一天里。
shots.textZone: one marigold #EFAE33 tab overlapping the bottom-left corner of the rounded photo card holding 「{callout_1}」, below it headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 30pt and two lines 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 at 14pt

shots.intent: 正交立面配三条竖向金盏标签把围挡挡边、背架槽与抽屉纵深一次讲清，是全页机制解释的核心一图。
shots.textZone: right label column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and three vertical marigold capsule tags 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 each joined by a 1px dotted leader line to its own part

shots.intent: 把不同抽屉数与功能位选配压成四张同角度同曝光卡，让买家一步完成选型不在评论区间犹豫。
shots.textZone: one section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 across the top band with a hairline underline and a three-slash /// mark at the right; one marigold #EFAE33 label bar under each card 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 低角度掠射微距把台面圆角、边部封边与木纹走向做实，用可见做工替代任何等级与环保话术。
shots.textZone: two labels only: 「{callout_1}」 with a 1px dotted leader to the banding line and 「{callout_2}」 to the rounded corner, both on small #F4F5F2 cards

shots.intent: 高角度俯看整张书桌在书房角的实际占地与地毯边界，用椅子和邻柜锚定真实尺度。
shots.textZone: left band: kicker label 「{callout_1}」 over headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 28pt and one sub line 「{callout_2}」 at 14pt

shots.intent: 同机位同光对比物件摊在台面前与收进围挡后侧抽屉后，让人自己看出台面净空差而不用一句功效话术。
shots.textZone: two small marigold #EFAE33 label bars, 「{callout_1}」 on the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 on the right panel, one centre seam headline 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把腿截面的收分、加高底座与圆形金属拉手一次看清，用可见结构与五金替掉稳固与资质主张。
shots.textZone: upper-right band: 「{callout_1}」 with a 1px dotted leader to the knob and 「{callout_2}」 to the leg-to-apron joint, one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 24pt above them

shots.intent: 把到货状态摊成一箱一物加四张图标卡，用可核验的包装实拍降低大件家具下单前的运损顾虑。
shots.textZone: section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a hairline underline and a three-slash /// mark, then four rounded-square chip cards 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 以一张干净的晨间台面收口全页，配一块只有占位行的信息卡和一条明确行动指令，把选型焦虑转成下单动作。
shots.textZone: upper right: a rounded #F4F5F2 info card with square-ended hairline rules and four rows of placeholder values 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, closing headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one marigold #EFAE33 action chip 「{callout_5}」

style.backgroundSystem: one cool study corner reused across every frame: chalk-matte plaster wall #F4F5F2 with a slim pale skirting #E9EBE7, pale micro-cement floor #DCDCD7 under an ash loop-pile carpet #D6D4CF, one sheer-curtain window band always kept at the camera-left edge; infographic screens switch to one flat mist card field #E4E8E4 with square-ended hairline rules and a marigold #EFAE33 label bar; photo panels are rounded cards with a 28px corner radius and one marigold tab overlapping a bottom corner; one clean text zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: cool-daylight light-timber study-desk ecommerce, airy north-window interior with a flat mist-grey infographic system rather than a cozy timber room
style.iconSystem: solid filled pictograms inside 4px-radius rounded-square chips, one chip per point in marigold #EFAE33 with #2A2E2C glyphs or in deep conifer #2F5D50 with #E4E8E4 glyphs, plus vertical marigold capsule tags joined to parts by 1px dotted leader lines, maximum four per screen, no thin-line outline circles, no 3D glossy badges
style.lightingSystem: soft north-window daylight entering from camera LEFT at 6500K with a low right-side bounce fill, short shadow tips all running to the right, one dry raking pass along shelf edges and grain, believable grounded contact shadow under every leg and every chair foot; never a warm sunset cast, never flat shadowless studio, never a second contradictory source, no lamp glow except one cool 4000K practical where stated

lighting system of soft north-window daylight from camera LEFT at 6500K with a low right-side bounce, short shadow tips all running right, one dry raking pass along shelf edges and grain and a grounded contact shadow under every leg, never a warm sunset cast, never flat shadowless studio, never a contradictory second source; icon system of solid filled pictograms inside 4px-radius rounded-square chips in marigold #EFAE33 with #2A2E2C glyphs or deep conifer #2F5D50 with #E4E8E4 glyphs, plus vertical marigold capsule tags on 1px dotted leader lines, at most four per screen, no thin-line outline circles; product presentation keeps identical desk proportion, guard band height, drawer count, knob form, leg profile and tabletop banding in every frame, straight corrected verticals, a real chair with an ash upholstered seat #8C8880 or a table lamp as scale anchor, contact shadow under every foot, no mechanism implied that the reference does not show, any person anonymous and cropped and never a child alone at a mechanism; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no lighting moved to the other side or contradictory shadows, no mismatched icon styles, no changed drawer count or leg profile, no invented timber species, board grade, eco or formaldehyde claim, load rating, dimension, height-adjustment range, warranty year or certificate, no brand or QR or membership wording, no warm amber tint.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or light moved to the other side

style.presentationRules: identical desk proportion, back guard band height, drawer count, knob form, leg profile section and tabletop rim banding in every frame; verticals corrected and straight; a real chair with an ash-toned upholstered seat #8C8880 or a table lamp used as scale anchor so furniture size reads true against a person-height seat; product stands on the carpet or floor with a believable contact shadow, never floating, nothing clipped at the base; the fixed frame is shown as a fixed frame, no mechanism implied that the reference does not show; if any person appears they are anonymous, cropped at torso or forearm only, never a face and never a child left alone at a drawer, shelf or fixing point
style.surfaceSystem: the supplied finish rendered exactly as sent: light timber faces with visible open grain and honest rim edge banding at the tabletop, a raised back guard band with its trough, drawer fronts and small turned metal knob pulls at exactly the supplied count, four tapered round legs with a raised base rail; matte, no gloss repaint, no plastic sheen, no re-grained surface
style.typography: one high-contrast bold geometric Chinese sans for headlines paired with a small light grotesque English label carrying a hairline underline in the top-right corner; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, headline 30-40pt, subtitle 14-18pt, labels 10-13pt, total copy budget under 50 characters per screen, no dense body text, no letter-spaced uppercase Latin kicker line
